email.subject: Your GovAI password was changed
body: Your GovAI password was successfully changed.
If you made this change, no further action is needed.
If you didn't make this change, open GovAI and use Forgot password
on the login page to reset your password.
Never share your password or verification code.

in_app.title: Password changed
body: Your GovAI password was changed. If this wasn't you,
use Forgot password on the login page to reset it.
